attribution: exact job/repository labels mapped using signatures from up to three latest successful runs within 21 days; retired signatures and historical worker-pool assignments are not inferred
deduplication: union bug_ids and fixed_bug_ids when aggregating jobs
fixed_definition: distinct linked bug with at least one non-invalid alert whose effective summary is Fixed (7) or linked cached Bugzilla bug is RESOLVED/VERIFIED/CLOSED with resolution FIXED or DUPLICATE; patch attachments are not counted
